title: RFC 3977 conformance tests use real Python nntplib — not mocked
description: crates/integration-tests/tests/nntp_conformance.rs spawns an actual Python nntplib client against a live reader process and validates RFC 3977 responses end-to-end. This is the only test that validates the full wire protocol path (TCP framing, dot-termination, response codes, CAPABILITIES negotiation) against an unmodified reference client. A contributor might suggest replacing this with a mocked TCP test or a Rust-native client — that would lose the cross-language oracle and could mask bugs in NNTP framing or state machine transitions. This test is uniquely valuable and must never be replaced by a same-language mock.
